links.outcome: Temporal consistency of LLM responses to identical scenarios across three time points over two weeks
links.effect: ChatGPT-4 temporally stable (p>0.05); Gemini consistent for complicated but not uncomplicated cases; Claude 3.5 Sonnet showed significant temporal inconsistencies (p<0.05).
links.quote: Claude 3.5 Sonnet exhibited significant temporal inconsistencies (p < 0.05).

screen.reason: The study empirically evaluates and compares the performance and temporal consistency of commercial LLMs (ChatGPT-4o, Gemini 1.5 Pro, Claude 3.5 Sonnet) on aesthetic surgery case vignettes graded by expert surgeons, but does not test a specific deployment practice or guardrail.
